dogecoin.text: UPDATE: 🇺🇸 The SEC has officially acknowledged Grayscale’s filings for XRP and Dogecoin ETFs. 🚀 https://t.co/RA8aTgZsJu

🚨 Yesterday, the 🇺🇸 SEC postponed decisions on:

XRP, Solana, Litecoin, and Dogecoin ETFs
In-kind creation/redemption for spot BTC and ETH ETFs
Staking in Ethereum ETFs
Experts say this is standard procedure, as new SEC Chair Paul Atkins is still awaiting official confirmation.
